legal_findings: The July1 signed transmittal expressly submits the final report to the President. GSA section20a independently records reporting to the President that day. These are occurrence evidence, independently of the deadline and title-page date.

Parent section4(e) terminates the Commission thirty days after submitting its report unless the President extends it. Thirty days after July1 gives July31; the GSA ExpectedTermDate agrees. GSA ActualTermDate and member end dates say August1 and remain distinct administrative counterevidence.

The administrative report identifies EO13227 as termination authority and repeats the thirty-day rule; no separate Presidential extension is identified. An administrative date field does not amend that rule. July31 is supported as legal cessation, while the meaning of August1 remains undetermined. A first-inactive-day convention is possible but unproved.

EO13316 sections3(c),6 supplies formal revocation September30 2003. This later event does not displace the earlier conditional sunset. Report production/export dates are distinct from the submission act.
residuals: Conditional accrued support/travel/payment consequences under parent section4(a)-(b), independent IDEA rights and lawful records duties do not prolong Commission authority. No specific unpaid obligation is proved.
